    .navbar {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.97);
        box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.09);
        margin-left: var(--proposal-sidebar-width);
        min-height: var(--proposal-topbar-height);
        padding: 0 1.5rem;
        width: calc(100% - var(--proposal-sidebar-width));
        z-index: 1035;
    }

    .navbar .container-xl {
        gap: 0;
        padding-left: 12px;
        padding-right: 12px;
    }

    .navbar-authenticated .navbar-brand {
        display: none !important;
    }

    .global-search-shell {
        margin-right: auto;
        max-width: 500px;
    }

    .global-search {
        background: #f8faff;
        border-color: #d7e0ed;
        color: #17345f;
        min-height: 52px;
    }

    .global-search input {
        color: #17345f;
    }

    .global-search input::placeholder {
        color: #71809a;
    }

    .global-search kbd {
        background: #fff;
        border-color: #dce4ef;
        color: #71809a;
    }

    .navbar .nav-link {
        color: #18355e !important;
    }

    .navbar .nav-link:hover,
    .navbar .nav-link.active {
        background: #edf3fb;
        color: #072f68 !important;
    }

    .user-nav-name strong {
        color: #071f43;
    }

    .user-nav-name small {
        color: #71809a;
        opacity: 1;
    }

    .nav-icon-badge {
        border-color: #fff;
    }

    .content-wrapper {
        padding-left: var(--proposal-sidebar-width);
    }

    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--proposal-navy-deep) 0%, var(--proposal-navy) 58%, #043d82 100%) !important;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        inset: 0 auto 0 0;
        max-height: none;
        max-width: var(--proposal-sidebar-width);
        min-height: 100vh;
        min-width: var(--proposal-sidebar-width) !important;
        overflow-x: hidden;
        overflow-y: auto;
        padding: 24px 20px 18px;
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        width: var(--proposal-sidebar-width) !important;
        z-index: 1040;
    }

    .sidebar-profile {
        margin-bottom: 20px;
        padding: 0 6px 24px;
    }

    .sidebar-profile-photo {
        height: 58px;
        width: 58px;
    }

    .sidebar-item,
    .sidebar-group summary {
        min-height: 52px;
        padding: 13px 16px;
    }

    .sidebar-item.active,
    .sidebar-group[open] summary {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0757c5 0%, #126bdc 100%);
        box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 50, 128, 0.26);
    }

    .sidebar-footer-brand {
        margin-top: auto;
    }

    html.sgpi-sidebar-collapsed .navbar {
        margin-left: var(--proposal-sidebar-collapsed);
        width: calc(100% - var(--proposal-sidebar-collapsed));
    }

    html.sgpi-sidebar-collapsed .content-wrapper {
        padding-left: var(--proposal-sidebar-collapsed);
    }

    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed {
        max-width: var(--proposal-sidebar-collapsed);
        min-width: var(--proposal-sidebar-collapsed) !important;
        padding-left: 10px;
        padding-right: 10px;
        width: var(--proposal-sidebar-collapsed) !important;
    }

    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand div,
    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-online,
    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-footer-brand {
        display: none;
    }

    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand {
        justify-content: center;
        margin-left: 0;
        margin-right: 0;
    }

    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand img {
        height: 48px;
        width: 48px;
    }

    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-collapse-control {
        transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    .main-content {
        min-width: 0;
        width: 100%;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) and (min-width: 769px) {
    .navbar .nav-link {
        font-size: 0;
        min-width: 42px;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .navbar .nav-link i {
        font-size: 1.1rem;
    }

    .user-nav-name {
        display: none;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .sidebar-brand {
        margin-top: 42px;
    }

    .navbar-sidebar-toggle {
        display: none;
    }

    .dashboard-action-panel {
        align-items: flex-start;
        grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr);
        padding: 22px;
    }

    .dashboard-action-icon {
        font-size: 2.2rem;
        height: 64px;
        width: 64px;
    }

    .dashboard-action-link {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .dashboard-stat-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    }

    .dashboard-stat-icon {
        height: 60px;
        width: 60px;
    }
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar {
    background: #18283f;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-sidebar-toggle,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar .nav-link,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .user-nav-name strong {
    color: #e7eef9 !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-sidebar-toggle:hover,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar .nav-link:hover,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar .nav-link.active,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar .nav-link.show {
    background: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.14) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar .dropdown-toggle::after {
    border-top-color: currentColor;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .global-search {
    background: #111d30;
    border-color: #3a4b64;
    color: #e7eef9;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .global-search input {
    color: #f1f5f9;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .global-search input::placeholder {
    color: #91a1b8;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .global-search kbd {
    background: #f8fafc;
    border-color: #d5dce6;
    color: #334155;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .user-nav-name small {
    color: #a9b7ca;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .nav-icon-badge {
    border-color: #18283f;
}

@media (min-width: 769px) {
    .navbar-authenticated .navbar-brand {
        display: none !important;
    }
}

/* Loader de navegación: emblema circular y etiqueta */
.sgpi-page-transition {
    backdrop-filter: blur(9px);
    background:
        radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(35, 130, 255, 0.11), transparent 25%),
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--soft-bg) 86%, transparent);
}

.sgpi-page-transition-panel {
    align-items: center;
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 22px;
    grid-template-columns: none;
    overflow: visible;
    padding: 16px;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-panel::before,
.sgpi-page-transition-panel::after {
    display: none;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-mark {
    height: 126px;
    width: 126px;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-label {
    color: var(--text-dark);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 750;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-bg) 75%, transparent);
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .sgpi-page-transition-panel {
        display: flex;
        gap: 18px;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 12px;
        width: auto;
    }

    .sgpi-page-transition-mark {
        height: 108px;
        width: 108px;
    }

    .sgpi-page-transition-label {
        font-size: 0.92rem;
    }
}

/* Public navigation does not reserve space for the authenticated sidebar. */
.navbar-public {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.97);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.1);
    margin-left: 0 !important;
    min-height: 82px;
    padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
    width: 100% !important;
}

.navbar-public .container-xl {
    gap: 1.5rem;
    max-width: 1640px;
}

.navbar-public .navbar-brand {
    color: #102f59 !important;
    gap: 14px;
}

.navbar-public .navbar-brand img {
    filter: drop-shadow(0 5px 10px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.15));
    height: 58px;
}

.navbar-public .navbar-brand-text span:first-child {
    color: #45566f;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.navbar-public .navbar-brand-text span:last-child {
    color: #102f59;
    font-size: 1rem;
}

.navbar-public .nav-link {
    border-radius: 10px;
    color: #18355e !important;
    font-weight: 650;
    padding: 0.72rem 0.9rem !important;
}

.navbar-public .nav-link:hover,
.navbar-public .nav-link.active {
    background: #edf3fb;
    color: #072f68 !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public {
    background: rgba(23, 32, 51, 0.98);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.26);
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .navbar-brand,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .navbar-brand-text span:first-child,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .navbar-brand-text span:last-child,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .nav-link {
    color: #eaf2ff !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .nav-link:hover,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .nav-link.active {
    background: rgba(147, 197, 253, 0.13);
    color: #ffffff !important;
}

@media (max-width: 991.98px) {
    .navbar-public {
        min-height: 72px;
        padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
    }

    .navbar-public .container-xl {
        gap: 0.75rem;
        position: relative;
    }

    .navbar-public .navbar-brand img {
        height: 48px;
    }

    .navbar-public .navbar-brand-text span:first-child {
        display: none;
    }

    .navbar-public .navbar-brand-text span:last-child {
        font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .navbar-public .navbar-toggler {
        align-items: center;
        background: #eef4fb;
        border: 1px solid #d7e2ef;
        border-radius: 10px;
        display: inline-flex !important;
        height: 44px;
        justify-content: center;
        margin-left: auto;
        padding: 0;
        position: absolute;
        right: 0;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        width: 44px;
        z-index: 2;
    }

    .navbar-public .navbar-toggler-icon {
        filter: brightness(0) saturate(100%) invert(18%) sepia(36%) saturate(1660%) hue-rotate(177deg);
        height: 1.25rem;
        width: 1.25rem;
    }

    .navbar-public .navbar-collapse {
        background: #ffffff;
        border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
        box-shadow: 0 14px 26px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.14);
        padding: 0.6rem;
    }

    :root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .navbar-toggler-icon {
        filter: brightness(0) invert(1);
    }

    :root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .navbar-toggler {
        background: #24324a;
        border-color: #41516b;
    }

    :root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .navbar-collapse {
        background: #172033;
        border-color: #344158;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 575.98px) {
    .navbar-public .navbar-brand-text {
        display: none;
    }
}

/* Mobile data and interaction layer */
.mobile-details-control {
    display: none;
}

.users-mobile-options-toggle,
.users-mobile-actions,
.users-filter-label {
    display: none;
}

.navbar-mobile-emblem,
.dashboard-mobile-shortcuts {
    display: none;
}

.users-filter-section {
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    body {
        overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    .navbar-authenticated .container-xl {
        justify-content: flex-start;
        min-height: 48px;
        padding-left: 8px;
        padding-right: 8px;
        position: relative;
    }

    .navbar-authenticated .navbar-brand,
    .navbar-authenticated > .container-xl > .navbar-toggler,
    .navbar-authenticated .navbar-collapse {
        display: none !important;
    }

    body.sidebar-mobile-open {
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .main-content {
        overflow: clip;
    }

    .navbar-sidebar-toggle {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
        border-radius: 10px;
        color: #fff;
        display: inline-flex;
        flex: 0 0 46px;
        font-size: 1.55rem;
        height: 46px;
        margin: 0;
        width: 46px;
    }

    .navbar-sidebar-toggle:hover,
    .navbar-sidebar-toggle:focus-visible {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
        border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
        color: #fff;
        outline: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
        outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .navbar-sidebar-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] {
        background: #fff;
        border-color: #fff;
        color: var(--primary-blue) !important;
    }

    .navbar-mobile-emblem {
        align-items: center;
        display: inline-flex;
        height: 52px;
        justify-content: center;
        left: 50%;
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
        width: 58px;
    }

    .navbar-mobile-emblem img {
        filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24));
        height: 48px;
        object-fit: contain;
        width: 48px;
    }

    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar,
    .sidebar {
        bottom: 0;
        box-shadow: 12px 0 32px rgba(2, 18, 43, 0.3);
        display: block !important;
        left: 0;
        max-height: none;
        max-width: min(300px, calc(100vw - 48px)) !important;
        min-height: 0;
        overflow-x: hidden;
        overflow-y: auto;
        padding: 18px 14px !important;
        position: fixed !important;
        top: calc(var(--sgpi-global-notice-height, 0px) + 64px);
        transform: translateX(-105%);
        transition: transform 220ms ease;
        width: min(300px, calc(100vw - 48px)) !important;
        z-index: 1060;
    }

    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar.show,
    .sidebar.show {
        transform: translateX(0);
    }

    .sidebar-brand {
        margin-top: 0;
    }

    .sidebar-collapse-control {
        display: none;
    }

    .sidebar-mobile-backdrop {
        background: rgba(3, 18, 40, 0.54);
        border: 0;
        display: block;
        inset: calc(var(--sgpi-global-notice-height, 0px) + 64px) 0 0;
        opacity: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
        position: fixed;
        transition: opacity 180ms ease;
        width: 100%;
        z-index: 1055;
    }

    .sidebar-mobile-backdrop.show {
        opacity: 1;
        pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .main-content > .container-xl {
        margin-bottom: 1.5rem !important;
        margin-top: 1.5rem !important;
    }

    .table-responsive {
        background: transparent;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 0;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
        overflow: visible;
    }

    .table-responsive:focus {
        outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 48%, transparent);
        outline-offset: 3px;
    }

    .mobile-card-table {
        background: transparent !important;
        border: 0;
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .mobile-card-table thead {
        border: 0;
        clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
        clip-path: inset(50%);
        height: 1px;
        margin: -1px;
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: 0;
        position: absolute;
        white-space: nowrap;
        width: 1px;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody {
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.85rem;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody tr {
        background: var(--surface-bg);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 16px;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.1);
        display: grid;
        min-width: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: 0.65rem 1rem 0.8rem;
        position: relative;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody tr::before {
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary-blue), var(--secondary-blue));
        content: "";
        height: 4px;
        inset: 0 0 auto;
        position: absolute;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody tr:hover {
        background: var(--surface-bg);
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody td {
        align-items: start;
        background: transparent !important;
        border: 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        color: var(--text-dark);
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.75rem;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(7rem, 38%) minmax(0, 1fr);
        min-width: 0;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        padding: 0.72rem 0.15rem;
        text-align: right;
        white-space: normal;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-primary {
        align-items: start;
        border-bottom: 0;
        gap: 0.28rem;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        padding-bottom: 0.48rem;
        padding-top: 0.85rem;
        text-align: left;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-primary::before {
        color: var(--primary-blue);
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-primary {
        color: var(--text-dark);
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 750;
        line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-summary {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--soft-bg) 72%, transparent) !important;
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
        padding: 0.62rem 0.7rem;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-detail {
        display: none;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tr.mobile-details-expanded .mobile-table-detail {
        display: grid;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody td::before {
        color: var(--text-muted);
        content: attr(data-label);
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.035em;
        line-height: 1.35;
        text-align: left;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody td:last-child {
        border-bottom: 0;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody td[colspan],
    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-status-row td {
        display: block;
        padding: 1.25rem 0.5rem;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody td[colspan]::before,
    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-status-row td::before,
    .mobile-card-table .mobile-cell-unlabelled::before {
        display: none;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-actions {
        align-items: center;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        margin-top: 0.25rem;
        order: 100;
        padding-top: 0.85rem;
        text-align: left;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-actions::before {
        margin-bottom: -0.2rem;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-actions .btn-group,
    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-actions > .d-flex {
        display: grid !important;
        gap: 0.45rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(42px, 1fr));
        width: 100%;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-actions .btn {
        align-items: center;
        display: inline-flex;
        justify-content: center;
        min-height: 42px;
        min-width: 42px;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-details-control {
        border: 0;
        display: block;
        order: 90;
        padding: 0.45rem 0 0;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-details-control::before {
        display: none;
    }

    .mobile-details-toggle {
        align-items: center;
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 8%, var(--surface-bg));
        border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 24%, var(--border-color));
        border-radius: 10px;
        color: var(--primary-blue);
        display: flex;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 750;
        gap: 0.75rem;
        justify-content: space-between;
        min-height: 42px;
        padding: 0.62rem 0.8rem;
        text-align: left;
        transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .mobile-details-toggle span {
        align-items: center;
        display: inline-flex;
        gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .mobile-details-toggle:hover,
    .mobile-details-toggle:focus-visible {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 14%, var(--surface-bg));
        border-color: var(--primary-blue);
        outline: 0;
    }

    .mobile-details-chevron {
        transition: transform 180ms ease;
    }

    .mobile-details-expanded .mobile-details-chevron {
        transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    .mobile-card-table tr.mobile-details-expanded {
        box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.14);
    }

    .mobile-scroll-table {
        min-width: 720px;
    }

    .table-responsive.mobile-scroll-region {
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 10px;
        overflow-x: auto;
    }

    .row.g-3 > [class*="col-"],
    .row.g-2 > [class*="col-"] {
        min-width: 0;
    }

    .main-content .input-group {
        flex-wrap: nowrap;
    }

    .main-content .input-group .form-control {
        min-width: 0;
    }

    .main-content .pagination {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.3rem;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .main-content .page-link {
        align-items: center;
        border-radius: 8px !important;
        display: inline-flex;
        justify-content: center;
        min-height: 42px;
        min-width: 42px;
    }

    .modal-dialog,
    .modal-dialog.modal-lg,
    .modal-dialog.modal-xl {
        margin: 0.5rem;
        max-width: calc(100vw - 1rem);
    }

    .modal-content {
        max-height: calc(100dvh - 1rem);
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .modal-body {
        overflow-x: hidden;
        overflow-y: auto;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
    }

    .modal-footer {
        background: var(--surface-bg);
        border-top-color: var(--border-color);
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        position: sticky;
        bottom: 0;
    }

    .modal-footer .btn {
        margin: 0;
        min-height: 44px;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .dropdown-menu {
        max-width: calc(100vw - 1.5rem);
    }

    .form-control,
    .form-select,
    .input-group-text {
        min-height: 44px;
    }

    textarea.form-control {
        min-height: 7rem;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcuts {
        background:
            linear-gradient(145deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 7%, var(--surface-bg)), var(--surface-bg));
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 16px;
        box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.1);
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
        padding: 1rem;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcuts-heading {
        align-items: center;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcuts-heading span {
        color: var(--text-muted);
        display: block;
        font-size: 0.68rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcuts-heading h2 {
        color: var(--text-dark);
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        margin: 0.15rem 0 0;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcuts-heading > i {
        align-items: center;
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 10%, var(--surface-bg));
        border-radius: 10px;
        color: var(--primary-blue);
        display: inline-flex;
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        height: 40px;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 40px;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcuts-grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.6rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcut {
        align-items: center;
        background: var(--surface-bg);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 12px;
        color: var(--text-dark);
        display: flex;
        gap: 0.65rem;
        min-height: 62px;
        padding: 0.65rem;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcut > i {
        align-items: center;
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 9%, var(--surface-bg));
        border-radius: 9px;
        color: var(--primary-blue);
        display: inline-flex;
        flex: 0 0 38px;
        font-size: 1rem;
        height: 38px;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcut span {
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 750;
        line-height: 1.2;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcut:active,
    .dashboard-mobile-shortcut:focus-visible {
        border-color: var(--primary-blue);
        box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(27, 57, 106, 0.15);
        color: var(--primary-blue);
        outline: 0;
        transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .users-desktop-actions {
        display: none !important;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-toggle {
        align-items: center;
        background: var(--surface-bg);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 12px;
        box-shadow: 0 5px 16px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.08);
        color: var(--text-dark);
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
        min-height: 58px;
        padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
        text-align: left;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-toggle > span {
        align-items: center;
        display: flex;
        gap: 0.75rem;
        min-width: 0;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-toggle > span > i {
        align-items: center;
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 10%, var(--surface-bg));
        border-radius: 9px;
        color: var(--primary-blue);
        display: inline-flex;
        flex: 0 0 38px;
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        height: 38px;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-toggle strong,
    .users-mobile-options-toggle small {
        display: block;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-toggle strong {
        font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-toggle small {
        color: var(--text-muted);
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        margin-top: 0.1rem;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-chevron {
        color: var(--text-muted);
        transition: transform 180ms ease;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .users-mobile-options-chevron {
        transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    .users-mobile-options {
        max-height: 0;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        opacity: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        transition: max-height 280ms ease, margin-bottom 220ms ease, opacity 160ms ease;
    }

    .users-mobile-options.show {
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.85rem;
        max-height: 720px;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
        opacity: 1;
        overflow: visible;
    }

    .users-mobile-actions {
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .users-mobile-actions .btn {
        align-items: center;
        display: inline-flex;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        gap: 0.4rem;
        justify-content: center;
        min-height: 46px;
        white-space: normal;
    }

    .users-filter-section {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--soft-bg) 68%, transparent);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 12px;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        padding: 0.7rem;
    }

    .users-filter-label {
        color: var(--text-muted);
        display: block;
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .users-filter-section .d-flex {
        display: grid !important;
        gap: 0.5rem !important;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .users-filter-section .btn {
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        min-height: 42px;
        white-space: normal;
        width: 100%;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .main-content > .container-xl,
    .container-xl {
        padding-left: 0.75rem;
        padding-right: 0.75rem;
    }

    .card-body {
        padding: 0.85rem;
    }

    .card-body.p-0 {
        padding: 0 !important;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody td {
        gap: 0.25rem;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        text-align: left;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-summary {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(6.5rem, auto) minmax(0, 1fr);
        text-align: right;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody td::before {
        margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
    }

    .main-content .d-flex.flex-wrap.gap-2 > .btn {
        flex: 1 1 calc(50% - 0.5rem);
    }

    .modal-footer {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

@media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) {
    .btn,
    .nav-link,
    .sidebar-item,
    .sidebar-group summary,
    .dropdown-item,
    .form-check-label {
        touch-action: manipulation;
    }

    .btn:hover,
    .card:hover {
        transform: none;
    }
}

/* Scroll independiente para el menú lateral */
.content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
    max-height: calc(100vh - var(--app-navbar-height, 70px));
    overflow-x: hidden;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    padding-bottom: 78px;
    scrollbar-gutter: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
    height: 0;
    width: 0;
}

@supports (height: 100dvh) {
    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
        max-height: calc(100dvh - var(--app-navbar-height, 70px));
    }
}

@media (min-width: 769px) {
    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
        position: sticky;
        top: var(--app-navbar-height, 70px);
        align-self: flex-start;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
        bottom: 0;
        max-height: calc(100vh - var(--app-navbar-height, 60px));
    }

    @supports (height: 100dvh) {
        .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
            max-height: calc(100dvh - var(--app-navbar-height, 60px));
        }
    }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar,
    .sidebar,
    .sidebar-mobile-backdrop {
        transition: none;
    }
}

@media (min-width: 769px) {
    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
        bottom: auto;
        max-height: 100vh;
        min-height: 100vh;
        position: fixed !important;
        top: 0 !important;
    }

    @supports (height: 100dvh) {
        .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
            max-height: 100dvh;
            min-height: 100dvh;
        }
    }
}

// Shared by the React and PHP clients. All user-provided content is rendered as text.
export function mountAcademicConsole(root, api, user, initialTab = 'periods') {
  let disposed = false
  let tab = initialTab
  let catalog
  const profile = Number(user.active_profile_id ?? user.perfil_id)
  const general = Boolean(user.is_general_admin) || profile === 4
  const manager = general || [1, 5].includes(profile)
  const academic = manager || profile === 6
  const student = profile === 3
  const el = (tag, text, attrs = {}) => Object.assign(document.createElement(tag), attrs, text === undefined ? {} : { textContent: String(text) })
  const error = (e) => e.response?.data?.message || e.response?.data?.error || Object.values(e.response?.data?.errors || {}).flat().join(' ') || e.message || 'No fue posible completar la operación.'
  const panel = (title, parent) => { const node = el('section', undefined, { className: 'panel', style: 'padding:20px;margin-bottom:16px' }); node.append(el('h2', title)); parent.append(node); return node }
  const button = (label, action, parent) => {
    const node = el('button', label, { type: 'button', className: 'btn btn-outline-primary', style: 'margin:4px' })
    node.onclick = async () => { node.disabled = true; try { await action() } catch (e) { status.textContent = error(e) } finally { node.disabled = false } }
    parent.append(node); return node
  }
  const input = (form, title, name, type = 'text', value = '', required = true) => {
    const label = el('label', title, { style: 'display:block;margin:10px 0' })
    const field = el('input', undefined, { name, type, value: type === 'checkbox' ? 'on' : (value ?? ''), required, className: 'form-control' })
    label.append(field); form.append(label); return field
  }
  const select = (form, title, name, options, value = '', required = true) => {
    const label = el('label', title, { style: 'display:block;margin:10px 0' })
    const field = el('select', undefined, { name, required, className: 'form-select' })
    field.append(el('option', 'Selecciona', { value: '' }))
    for (const [id, text] of options) field.append(el('option', text, { value: String(id) }))
    field.value = value == null ? '' : String(value); label.append(field); form.append(label); return field
  }
  const form = (parent, submitLabel, submit) => {
    const node = el('form'); parent.append(node)
    const finish = () => {
      const send = el('button', submitLabel, { type: 'submit', className: 'btn btn-primary' }); node.append(send)
      node.onsubmit = async (event) => {
        event.preventDefault(); send.disabled = true; status.textContent = 'Guardando…'
        try { await submit(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(node))); status.textContent = 'Operación completada.'; await render() }
        catch (e) { status.textContent = error(e) }
        finally { send.disabled = false }
      }
    }
    return [node, finish]
  }
  const periods = () => catalog.periods.map(p => [p.id, p.nombre])
  const projects = () => catalog.projects.map(p => [p.id, p.titulo])
  const members = (roles) => catalog.members.filter(m => roles.includes(Number(m.perfil_id))).map(m => [m.usuario_id, `${m.nombres} ${m.apellido_paterno} · ${m.usuario_id}`])
  const groups = (items = catalog.groups) => items.map(g => [g.id, `${g.nombre} · ${g.semestre}° ${g.grupo || g.clave_grupo || ''}`])
  const date = value => value ? new Date(value).toLocaleString('es-MX') : '—'
  const request = (method, url, body) => api(method, url, body)
  const status = el('p', '', { role: 'status', ariaLive: 'polite' })
  const nav = el('nav', undefined, { ariaLabel: 'Operación académica', style: 'margin-bottom:16px' })
  const content = el('div')
  root.replaceChildren(nav, status, content)
  const tabs = [...(academic ? [['periods', 'Periodos y matrícula']] : []), ['courses', student ? 'Mis materias' : 'Inscripciones'], ...(!student ? [['authorizations', 'Autorizaciones']] : []), ...(manager ? [['memberships', 'Perfiles']] : []), ['residencies', 'Residencias'], ...(!student ? [['continuity', 'Continuidad']] : [])]
  if (!tabs.some(([id]) => id === tab)) tab = tabs[0][0]
  for (const [id, label] of tabs) button(label, async () => { tab = id; await render() }, nav)

  async function renderPeriods() {
    const data = await request('GET', '/semester-management')
    if (data.scheduler) content.append(el('p', `Última preparación automática: ${date(data.scheduler.updated_at)} · ${data.scheduler.estado}`))
    else content.append(el('p', 'Todavía no se ha registrado una preparación automática.'))
    const section = panel('Periodos por carrera', content)
    for (const p of data.periods) {
      const row = el('article', undefined, { style: 'padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #aaa' })
      row.append(el('strong', `${p.nombre} · ${p.operacion?.estado || 'sin preparar'} · ${p.operacion?.conciliado ? 'conciliado' : 'requiere conciliación'}`))
      if (manager) {
        button('Conciliar', () => reconciliation(p), row)
        for (const [state, label] of [['abierto', 'Abrir'], ['en_cierre', 'Iniciar cierre'], ['cerrado', 'Cerrar']]) button(label, async () => { await request('POST', `/semester-management/periods/${p.id}/transition`, { state }); await render() }, row)
      }
      button('Preparar promoción', () => promotion(p), row); section.append(row)
    }
    if (general) {
      const p = panel('Calendario institucional', content)
      const [f, done] = form(p, 'Crear periodo', d => request('POST', '/semester-management/periods', { ...d, automatic_promotion: false }))
      input(f, 'Nombre', 'name'); input(f, 'Inicio', 'starts_at', 'date'); input(f, 'Fin', 'ends_at', 'date'); done()
    }
    const p = panel('Asignar matrícula del periodo abierto', content)
    const [f, done] = form(p, 'Guardar matrícula', d => request('POST', '/academic-operations/enrollments', { student_id: d.student_id, group_id: Number(d.group_id) }))
    select(f, 'Alumno', 'student_id', members([3])); select(f, 'Grupo', 'group_id', groups()); done()
  }

  async function promotion(period) {
    const preview = await request('GET', `/semester-management/periods/${period.id}/promotion-preview`)
    content.replaceChildren(); const p = panel(`Promoción a ${period.nombre}`, content)
    p.append(el('p', 'Resuelve todos los movimientos. Noveno permanece en seguimiento; no se declara egreso.'))
    const [f, done] = form(p, manager ? 'Confirmar lote' : 'Sólo preparación: requiere jefatura o administrador', async () => {
      const movements = rows.map(r => ({ student_id: r.student, action: r.action.value, group_id: r.group.value ? Number(r.group.value) : null, reason: r.reason.value }))
      await request('POST', `/semester-management/periods/${period.id}/promote`, { operation_id: operationId, snapshot: preview.snapshot, movements })
    })
    const operationId = crypto.randomUUID()
    const rows = preview.movements.map((m, i) => {
      const box = panel(`${m.student_id} · ${m.from}° → ${m.to}°`, f)
      if (m.pending) box.append(el('p', m.pending))
      return { student: m.student_id, action: select(box, 'Movimiento', `action${i}`, [['avance', 'Avance'], ['permanencia', 'Permanencia'], ['salida', 'Salida del seguimiento']], m.action), group: select(box, 'Grupo destino', `group${i}`, groups(preview.groups), m.group_id, false), reason: input(box, 'Motivo', `reason${i}`) }
    })
    if (manager) done()
    else p.append(el('p', 'Solicita a jefatura o administración la confirmación del lote.'))
    button('Volver', render, p)
  }

  async function reconciliation(period) {
    const report = await request('GET', `/academic-operations/periods/${period.id}/reconciliation`)
    content.replaceChildren(); const p = panel(`Conciliación · ${period.nombre}`, content)
    p.append(el('p', 'Compara cada matrícula. Dejar grupo vacío excluye al alumno de este periodo y requiere un motivo.'))
    for (const old of report.legacy_exceptions) p.append(el('p', `Autorización histórica #${old.id}, proyecto ${old.proyecto_id}: ${old.motivo}. Debe revisarse y solicitarse nuevamente con alcance explícito.`))
    const [f, done] = form(p, 'Aplicar conciliación', async d => {
      await request('POST', `/academic-operations/periods/${period.id}/reconciliation`, { snapshot: report.snapshot,
        room_resolutions: roomRows.map(r => ({ room_id: r.id, period_id: Number(r.period.value), classroom_id: Number(r.classroom.value), reason: r.reason.value })),
        acknowledge_legacy_exceptions: d.ack === 'on', resolutions: rows.map(r => ({ student_id: r.student, group_id: r.group.value ? Number(r.group.value) : null, reason: r.reason.value })) })
    })
    const rows = report.students.map((s, i) => {
      const box = panel(`${s.name} · ${s.student_id}`, f)
      if (s.issue) box.append(el('p', s.issue))
      return { student: s.student_id, group: select(box, 'Grupo confirmado', `group${i}`, groups(report.groups), s.group_id, false), reason: input(box, 'Motivo / fuente verificada', `reason${i}`) }
    })
    const roomRows = (report.rooms || []).map((r, i) => {
      const box = panel(`Sala histórica #${r.id} · ${r.nombre || r.salon}`, f)
      box.append(el('p', `Periodos de los grupos originales: ${(r.candidate_periods || []).join(', ') || 'sin evidencia'}. Verifica el calendario antes de confirmar.`))
      return { id: r.id, period: select(box, 'Periodo confirmado', `roomPeriod${i}`, catalog.periods.map(p => [p.id, p.nombre]), r.periodo_id),
        classroom: select(box, 'Salón institucional', `roomClassroom${i}`, catalog.rooms.map(c => [c.id, c.nombre]), r.salon_id), reason: input(box, 'Fuente de verificación', `roomReason${i}`) }
    })
    input(f, 'He revisado las excepciones históricas y entiendo que requieren nueva autorización', 'ack', 'checkbox', '', report.legacy_exceptions.length > 0)
    done(); button('Volver', render, p)
  }

  async function renderCourses() {
    const data = await request('GET', '/course-enrollments')
    if (!data.data.length) content.append(el('p', 'No hay cursos en el periodo abierto de esta carrera.'))
    for (const c of data.data) {
      const p = panel(`${c.subject?.nombre || 'Materia'} · ${c.group?.semestre}° ${c.group?.grupo || ''}`, content)
      p.append(el('p', `Ventana: ${date(c.inscripcion_desde)} — ${date(c.inscripcion_hasta)}`))
      if (student) {
        if (!c.inscrito) {
          const [f, done] = form(p, 'Inscribirme', d => request('POST', `/course-enrollments/${c.id}`, d)); input(f, 'Clave del docente', 'password', 'password'); done()
        } else {
          p.append(el('strong', 'Inscrito'))
          const [f, done] = form(p, 'Solicitar baja directa', d => request('DELETE', `/course-enrollments/${c.id}`, d)); input(f, 'Motivo de baja', 'reason'); done()
        }
      } else {
        const [f, done] = form(p, 'Abrir inscripción / renovar clave', d => request('PUT', `/courses/${c.id}/self-enrollment`, { enabled: true, password: d.password, password_confirmation: d.password, starts_at: d.start, ends_at: d.end }))
        input(f, 'Nueva clave (mínimo 6 caracteres)', 'password', 'password').minLength = 6
        input(f, 'Apertura', 'start', 'datetime-local'); input(f, 'Cierre', 'end', 'datetime-local'); done()
        button('Cerrar autorregistro', async () => { await request('PUT', `/courses/${c.id}/self-enrollment`, { enabled: false }); await render() }, p)
        button('Ver inscritos', async () => {
          const data = await request('GET', `/courses/${c.id}/students`)
          const box = panel('Matrícula del curso', p)
          for (const s of data.data) box.append(el('p', `${s.id} · ${s.nombres} ${s.apellido_paterno} · ${s.pivot?.activo ? 'activo' : 'baja'}`))
          if (academic) { const [f, done] = form(box, 'Registrar baja administrativa', d => request('DELETE', `/course-enrollments/${c.id}`, d)); select(f, 'Alumno', 'student_id', data.data.map(s => [s.id, `${s.id} ${s.nombres}`])); input(f, 'Motivo', 'reason'); done() }
        }, p)
      }
    }
  }

  async function renderAuthorizations() {
    const data = await request('GET', '/academic-operations/authorizations')
    const p = panel('Solicitar autorización', content)
    const [f, done] = form(p, 'Registrar solicitud', d => request('POST', '/academic-operations/authorizations', {
      ...d, period_id: Number(d.period_id), project_id: d.project_id ? Number(d.project_id) : null,
      presentation_semester: d.presentation_semester ? Number(d.presentation_semester) : null,
      evaluation_id: d.evaluation_id ? Number(d.evaluation_id) : null, student_id: d.student_id || null,
      course_id: d.course_id ? Number(d.course_id) : null,
    }))
    select(f, 'Periodo', 'period_id', periods()); select(f, 'Tipo', 'type', [['presentacion_semestre', 'Presentación en otra etapa'], ['reprogramacion', 'Reprogramación'], ['reintento', 'Nuevo intento'], ...(manager ? [['inscripcion_semestre', 'Inscripción en otro semestre']] : [])])
    select(f, 'Proyecto (obligatorio para evaluaciones)', 'project_id', projects(), '', false)
    select(f, 'Alumno involucrado (no autoriza automáticamente al equipo)', 'student_id', members([3]), '', false)
    select(f, 'Etapa de presentación', 'presentation_semester', [5, 6, 7, 8].map(n => [n, `${n}°`]), '', false)
    select(f, 'Evaluación de origen', 'evaluation_id', (catalog.evaluations || []).map(e => [e.id, `${e.project?.title || e.project?.titulo || e.project_id} · ${e.semestre}° · ${e.estado} (#${e.id})`]), '', false)
    select(f, 'Materia (para inscripción excepcional)', 'course_id', (catalog.courses || []).map(c => [c.id, `${c.subject?.nombre} · ${c.group?.semestre}° ${c.group?.grupo || ''}`]), '', false)
    input(f, 'Motivo', 'reason'); input(f, 'Vigencia hasta', 'expires_at', 'datetime-local'); done()
    for (const a of data.data) {
      const box = panel(`${a.tipo} · ${a.estado}`, content); box.append(el('p', `Proyecto ${a.proyecto_id || '—'} · ${a.motivo} · vigencia ${date(a.vigente_hasta)}`))
      if (manager && ['solicitada', 'aprobada'].includes(a.estado) && !a.consumida_en) {
        const [f, done] = form(box, 'Registrar resolución', d => request('PUT', `/semester-management/exceptions/${a.id}/decision`, { version: a.version, status: d.status, reason: d.reason, project_scope: d.scope === 'on' }))
        select(f, 'Decisión', 'status', a.estado === 'solicitada' ? [['aprobada', 'Aprobar'], ['rechazada', 'Rechazar']] : [['revocada', 'Revocar']]); input(f, 'Motivo de resolución', 'reason'); input(f, 'Confirmo el alcance sobre todo el proyecto al aprobar', 'scope', 'checkbox', '', false); done()
      }
    }
  }

  async function renderMemberships() {
    const p = panel('Perfiles operativos de miembros actuales', content)
    p.append(el('p', 'Administración general gestiona altas, cambios de carrera, jefaturas y administradores. Los compromisos pendientes deben reasignarse antes de cambiar un perfil.'))
    const [f, done] = form(p, 'Asignar perfil', d => request('PUT', `/academic-operations/memberships/${d.membership}`, { profile_id: Number(d.profile_id) }))
    const field = select(f, 'Persona', 'membership', catalog.members.filter(m => [2, 3, 6, 7].includes(Number(m.perfil_id))).map(m => [m.id, `${m.nombres} ${m.apellido_paterno} · perfil ${m.perfil_id}`]))
    select(f, 'Perfil', 'profile_id', [[2, 'Docente'], [3, 'Estudiante'], [6, 'Asistencia'], [7, 'Coordinación']]); done()
    button('Consultar compromisos', async () => { if (!field.value) return; const commitments = await request('GET', `/academic-operations/memberships/${field.value}/commitments`); const box = panel('Compromisos pendientes', p); for (const [key, ids] of Object.entries(commitments)) box.append(el('p', `${({ courses: 'Cursos', rooms: 'Salas', projects: 'Asesorías', residencies: 'Residencias' })[key]}: ${ids.join(', ') || 'ninguno'}`)) }, p)
    if (general) { const box = panel('Catálogo institucional de salones', content); const [f, done] = form(box, 'Agregar salón', d => request('POST', '/academic-operations/classrooms', d)); input(f, 'Nombre del salón', 'name'); done() }
  }

  async function renderContinuity() {
    const p = panel('Seguimiento del proyecto en el periodo abierto', content)
    const [f, done] = form(p, 'Registrar continuidad', d => request('POST', '/academic-operations/project-period', { project_id: Number(d.project_id), group_id: Number(d.group_id) }))
    select(f, 'Proyecto', 'project_id', projects()); select(f, 'Grupo del periodo', 'group_id', groups()); done()
    p.append(el('p', 'La continuidad conserva el grupo, documentos y evaluaciones de los periodos anteriores.'))
  }

  async function renderResidencies() {
    const data = await request('GET', '/residencies')
    if (student || academic) {
      const p = panel('Nuevo expediente individual de residencia', content)
      const [f, done] = form(p, 'Crear expediente', d => {
        const project = catalog.projects.find(p => Number(p.id) === Number(d.project_id))
        return request('POST', '/residencies', { ...d, student_id: student ? user.id : d.student_id, period_id: Number(d.period_id), project_id: Number(d.project_id), company_id: project?.empresa_id })
      })
      if (!student) select(f, 'Residente', 'student_id', members([3]))
      select(f, 'Periodo', 'period_id', periods()); select(f, 'Proyecto asociado', 'project_id', projects())
      select(f, 'Origen', 'origin', [['empresa', 'Proyecto nuevo de empresa'], ['continuacion', 'Continuación del integrador']])
      select(f, 'Asesor asignado al proyecto', 'advisor_id', student ? (catalog.advisors || []).map(a => [a.id, `${a.nombres} ${a.apellido_paterno}`]) : members([1, 2, 5, 6, 7]))
      input(f, 'Alcance y cambios propuestos (mínimo 20 caracteres)', 'changes').minLength = 20; done()
    }
    for (const r of data.data) {
      const box = panel(`Residencia · ${r.estudiante_id} · ${r.estado}`, content)
      box.append(el('p', r.cambios_propuestos))
      for (const item of r.requirements) {
        const sub = panel(`${item.nombre}${item.obligatorio ? ' · obligatorio' : ''}`, box)
        for (const v of item.versions) {
          const line = el('div'); line.append(el('p', `Versión ${v.numero} · ${v.nombre} · ${v.estado} · ${v.observaciones || 'Sin observaciones'}`))
          button('Descargar', () => request('DOWNLOAD', `/residencies/${r.id}/versions/${v.id}/download`, { name: v.nombre }), line)
          if (r.estado === 'abierta' && String(user.id) === String(r.asesor_id) && v.estado === 'pendiente') {
            const [f, done] = form(line, 'Guardar revisión', d => request('PUT', `/residencies/${r.id}/versions/${v.id}/review`, d)); select(f, 'Resultado', 'status', [['correcciones', 'Solicitar correcciones'], ['validada', 'Validar']]); input(f, 'Observaciones', 'observations'); done()
          }
          sub.append(line)
        }
        if (r.estado === 'abierta' && String(user.id) === String(r.estudiante_id)) {
          const [f, done] = form(sub, 'Subir nueva versión', async () => { const data = new FormData(); data.append('file', file.files[0]); await request('POST', `/residencies/${r.id}/requirements/${item.id}/versions`, data) }); const file = input(f, 'Documento PDF o Word', 'file', 'file'); file.accept = '.pdf,.doc,.docx'; done()
        }
      }
      if (r.estado === 'abierta' && (academic || String(user.id) === String(r.asesor_id))) {
        const [f, done] = form(box, 'Agregar requisito documental', d => request('POST', `/residencies/${r.id}/requirements`, { name: d.name, required: d.required === 'on', deadline: d.deadline || null })); input(f, 'Nombre del requisito', 'name'); input(f, 'Obligatorio', 'required', 'checkbox', '', false).checked = true; input(f, 'Fecha límite opcional', 'deadline', 'datetime-local', '', false); done()
      }
      if (manager && r.estado === 'abierta') {
        const [af, adone] = form(box, 'Reasignar asesor', d => request('PUT', `/residencies/${r.id}/advisor`, { advisor_id: d.advisor_id, version: r.version, reason: d.reason }))
        select(af, 'Nuevo asesor asignado al proyecto', 'advisor_id', members([1, 2, 5, 6, 7]), r.asesor_id); input(af, 'Motivo de reasignación', 'reason'); adone()
        const [f, done] = form(box, 'Cerrar seguimiento', d => request('POST', `/residencies/${r.id}/close`, { version: r.version, reason: d.reason })); input(f, 'Motivo del cierre', 'reason'); done()
      }
    }
  }

  async function render() {
    if (disposed) return
    content.replaceChildren(el('p', 'Cargando…'))
    try {
      catalog = await request('GET', '/academic-operations/catalog')
      if (disposed) return
      content.replaceChildren()
      await ({ periods: renderPeriods, courses: renderCourses, authorizations: renderAuthorizations, memberships: renderMemberships, residencies: renderResidencies, continuity: renderContinuity })[tab]()
    } catch (e) { if (!disposed) { content.replaceChildren(el('p', error(e))); button('Reintentar', render, content) } }
  }
  render()
  return () => { disposed = true; root.replaceChildren() }
}

assets/js/activity-notifications.js

Fuente · 90 líneas · SHA-256 d5b96a1e9a632676477fea03a87cd7f4cf46d6b1a1a2704532a42201ac69d7bc

(() => {
    const icons = {
        actividad_habilitada: 'bi-journal-plus',
        actividad_entregada: 'bi-cloud-check',
        evaluacion_realizada: 'bi-clipboard-check'
    };

    function escapeHtml(value) {
        const element = document.createElement('div');
        element.textContent = String(value ?? '');
        return element.innerHTML;
    }

    function formatDate(value) {
        const date = new Date(value);
        if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return '';
        return date.toLocaleString('es-MX', {
            day: '2-digit',
            month: 'short',
            hour: '2-digit',
            minute: '2-digit'
        });
    }

    function render(response) {
        const list = document.getElementById('activityNotificationList');
        const badge = document.getElementById('activityNotificationBadge');
        const summary = document.getElementById('activityNotificationSummary');
        if (!list || !badge || !summary) return;

        const notifications = Array.isArray(response?.data) ? response.data : [];
        const unread = Number(response?.unread_count || 0);
        badge.hidden = unread === 0;
        badge.textContent = unread > 9 ? '9+' : String(unread);
        summary.textContent = unread === 1 ? '1 notificación sin leer' : `${unread} notificaciones sin leer`;

        if (!notifications.length) {
            list.innerHTML = '<div class="notification-empty"><i class="bi bi-envelope-open"></i><span>No hay actividad reciente.</span></div>';
            return;
        }

        list.innerHTML = notifications.map(notification => `
            <button type="button"
                class="notification-item activity-notification-item ${notification.leida_en ? '' : 'is-unread'}"
                data-notification-id="${notification.id}"
                data-notification-url="${escapeHtml(notification.url)}">
                <span class="notification-icon"><i class="bi ${icons[notification.tipo] || 'bi-info-circle'}"></i></span>
                <span>
                    <strong>${escapeHtml(notification.titulo)}</strong>
                    <p>${escapeHtml(notification.mensaje)}</p>
                    <small>${escapeHtml(formatDate(notification.creada_en))}</small>
                </span>
            </button>
        `).join('');
    }

    async function load() {
        try {
            render(await api.get('/activity-notifications', { _fresh: true }));
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn('No se pudieron cargar las notificaciones de actividad', error);
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        const menu = document.getElementById('activityNotificationMenu');
        const list = document.getElementById('activityNotificationList');
        const markAll = document.getElementById('markAllActivityNotifications');
        if (!menu || !list || !markAll || typeof api === 'undefined') return;

        menu.addEventListener('shown.bs.dropdown', load);
        list.addEventListener('click', async event => {
            const item = event.target.closest('[data-notification-id]');
            if (!item) return;
            const url = item.dataset.notificationUrl;
            try {
                await api.put(`/activity-notifications/${item.dataset.notificationId}/read`);
            } finally {
                if (url) window.location.href = url;
            }
        });
        markAll.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            await api.put('/activity-notifications/read-all');
            await load();
        });

        load();
        window.setInterval(load, 30000);
    });
})();

/**
 * Cliente de API
 * Gestiona todas las llamadas a la API REST
 */

class ApiClient {
    constructor() {
        this.baseURL = API_BASE_URL;
        this.timeout = 10000;
        this.cache = new Map();
        this.pending = new Map();
        this.refreshPromise = null;
        this.localMutationWindow = 10000;
        this.maxStoredCacheEntries = 50;
        this.resourceEndpoints = [
            '/evaluations/rubric-criteria',
            '/evaluations/rooms',
            '/proposal/assignments',
            '/proposal/exceptions',
            '/proposal/windows',
            '/proposal/projects',
            '/subject-groups',
            '/document-tags',
            '/evaluation-managers',
            '/deliverables',
            '/evaluations',
            '/competencias',
            '/asignaturas',
            '/repositorio',
            '/projects',
            '/notices',
            '/settings',
            '/semester-management',
            '/profile',
            '/users'
        ];
        this.cachePrefix = `sgpi-api-cache:v3:${this.baseURL}:`;
        this.defaultCacheTtls = [
            { pattern: /^\/dashboard\/(stats|teacher|student)$/, ttl: 20000 },
            { pattern: /^\/users(?:\/[^/]+)?$/, ttl: 30000 },
            { pattern: /^\/projects(?:\/[^/]+)?$/, ttl: 30000 },
            { pattern: /^\/asignaturas(?:\/[^/]+)?$/, ttl: 120000 },
            { pattern: /^\/competencias(?:\/[^/]+)?$/, ttl: 60000 },
            { pattern: /^\/subject-groups(?:\/[^/]+)?$/, ttl: 120000 },
            { pattern: /^\/document-tags(?:\/[^/]+)?$/, ttl: 60000 },
            { pattern: /^\/repositorio(?:\/[^/]+)?$/, ttl: 30000 },
            { pattern: /^\/deliverables(?:\/[^/]+)?$/, ttl: 20000 },
            { pattern: /^\/evaluations(?:\/.*)?$/, ttl: 20000 },
            { pattern: /^\/proposal\/student-status$/, ttl: 20000 },
            { pattern: /^\/student\/evaluation-schedule$/, ttl: 30000 },
            { pattern: /^\/settings\/public$/, ttl: 300000 },
            { pattern: /^\/settings$/, ttl: 60000 },
            { pattern: /^\/semester-management$/, ttl: 45000 },
            { pattern: /^\/proposal\/config$/, ttl: 30000 }
        ];
    }

    /**
     * GET request
     */
    async get(endpoint, params = {}) {
        return this.request('GET', endpoint, null, params);
    }

    /**
     * Precarga la siguiente página de una respuesta paginada.
     */
    prefetchNextPage(endpoint, params = {}, pagination = {}) {
        const currentPage = Number(pagination.current_page || params.page || 1);
        const lastPage = Number(pagination.last_page || 1);
        if (currentPage >= lastPage) return;

        const nextParams = {
            ...params,
            page: currentPage + 1,
            _silent: true
        };
        if (nextParams._cache_ttl === undefined) {
            nextParams._cache_ttl = this.defaultCacheTtl(endpoint);
        }

        this.get(endpoint, nextParams).catch(() => {
            // La precarga es opcional; la página se solicitará normalmente si falla.
        });
    }

    /**
     * POST request
     */
    async post(endpoint, data = {}, params = {}) {
        return this.request('POST', endpoint, data, params);
    }

    /**
     * PUT request
     */
    async put(endpoint, data = {}) {
        return this.request('PUT', endpoint, data);
    }

    /**
     * DELETE request
     */
    async delete(endpoint, data = null) {
        return this.request('DELETE', endpoint, data);
    }

    /**
     * Hacer petición HTTP
     */
    async request(method, endpoint, data = null, params = {}) {
        const url = new URL(`${this.baseURL}${endpoint}`);
        const normalizedParams = { ...params };
        const requestedCacheTtl = normalizedParams._cache_ttl;
        const requestTimeout = Number(normalizedParams._timeout || this.timeout);
        const cacheTtl = Number(requestedCacheTtl ?? (method === 'GET' ? this.defaultCacheTtl(endpoint) : 0));
        const forceFresh = Boolean(normalizedParams._fresh);
        const silent = Boolean(normalizedParams._silent);
        delete normalizedParams._cache_ttl;
        delete normalizedParams._fresh;
        delete normalizedParams._timeout;
        delete normalizedParams._silent;

        // Agregar parámetros
        Object.keys(normalizedParams).forEach(key => {
            const value = normalizedParams[key];
            if (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '') {
                url.searchParams.append(key, value);
            }
        });
        const cacheKey = `${method}:${url.toString()}`;

        if (method === 'GET') {
            const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey) || this.readStoredCache(cacheKey);
            const locallyUpdated = cached?.locallyUpdatedUntil > Date.now();
            const normallyValid = !forceFresh && cached?.expiresAt > Date.now();
            if (cached && (locallyUpdated || normallyValid)) {
                this.cache.set(cacheKey, cached);
                return cached.value;
            }
        }

        if (method === 'GET' && this.pending.has(cacheKey)) {
            return this.pending.get(cacheKey);
        }

        const options = {
            method,
            headers: {
                'Accept': 'application/json'
            }
        };

        // Agregar token si existe
        if (auth.getToken()) {
            options.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${auth.getToken()}`;
            if (auth.remember) options.headers['X-SGPI-Remember'] = '1';
        }

        // Agregar body si existe
        if (data) {
            if (data instanceof FormData) {
                options.body = data;
            } else {
                options.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
                options.body = JSON.stringify(data);
            }
        } else {
            options.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
        }

        const executeRequest = async (retryingAfterRefresh = false) => {
            const controller = new AbortController();
            const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), requestTimeout);
            const response = await fetch(url, { ...options, credentials: 'include', signal: controller.signal })
                .finally(() => clearTimeout(timeoutId));

            // Si no está autenticado (401)
            if (response.status === 401) {
                const canRefresh = auth.getToken()
                    && endpoint !== '/auth/refresh'
                    && endpoint !== '/auth/logout'
                    && !retryingAfterRefresh;

                if (canRefresh) {
                    try {
                        const freshToken = await this.refreshAuthToken();
                        options.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${freshToken}`;
                        return executeRequest(true);
                    } catch (refreshError) {
                        if (refreshError?.authTerminal) {
                            this.redirectToLogout('expired');
                        }
                        throw refreshError;
                    }
                }

                this.redirectToLogout('unauthorized');
                throw new Error('Sesión expirada. Inicia sesión nuevamente.');
            }

            const result = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

            if (!response.ok) {
                const validationMessage = result.errors ? Object.values(result.errors).flat().join(' ') : '';
                const error = new Error(this.translateError(result.message || result.error || validationMessage || 'Error en la solicitud'));
                error.status = response.status;
                error.result = result;
                error.errors = result.errors || null;
                throw error;
            }

            if (method === 'GET') {
                const cachedValue = {
                    value: result,
                    expiresAt: cacheTtl > 0 ? Date.now() + cacheTtl : 0,
                    locallyUpdatedUntil: 0,
                    endpoint: this.normalizeEndpoint(endpoint),
                    storedAt: Date.now()
                };
                this.cache.set(cacheKey, cachedValue);
                if (cacheTtl > 0) {
                    this.writeStoredCache(cacheKey, cachedValue);
                }
            } else if (method !== 'GET') {
                this.applyMutationToCache(method, endpoint, data, result);
            }

            return result;
        };

        if (!silent) {
            document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sgpi:request-start', {
                detail: { method, endpoint }
            }));
        }
        try {
            if (method === 'GET') {
                const pendingRequest = executeRequest().finally(() => this.pending.delete(cacheKey));
                this.pending.set(cacheKey, pendingRequest);
                return await pendingRequest;
            }

            return await executeRequest();
        } catch (error) {
            if (method === 'GET') {
                this.pending.delete(cacheKey);
            }
            if (error.name === 'AbortError') {
                const timeoutError = new Error('La solicitud tardo demasiado. Intenta nuevamente.');
                timeoutError.name = 'AbortError';
                error = timeoutError;
            }
            if (!silent) {
                console.error('Error en la solicitud:', error);
            }
            throw error;
        } finally {
            if (!silent) {
                document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sgpi:request-end', {
                    detail: { method, endpoint }
                }));
            }
        }
    }

    clearCache() {
        this.cache.clear();
        this.pending.clear();
        try {
            Object.keys(sessionStorage)
                .filter(key => key.startsWith(this.cachePrefix))
                .forEach(key => sessionStorage.removeItem(key));
        } catch (error) {
            // La limpieza en memoria ya evita reutilizar datos dentro de la página actual.
        }
    }

    applyMutationToCache(method, endpoint, requestData, result) {
        const resource = this.resourceEndpoint(endpoint);
        const mutationId = this.endpointId(endpoint);
        const entity = this.mutationEntity(result, requestData, mutationId);
        const now = Date.now();
        const retained = [];

        // Proyectos tiene colecciones mutuamente excluyentes por modalidad y
        // tipo. Parchar todas las cachés haría aparecer temporalmente una alta
        // o un cambio de modalidad en pestañas que no le corresponden.
        if (resource === '/projects') {
            this.cache.forEach((cached, cacheKey) => {
                if (this.cacheMatchesResource(cached?.endpoint, resource)) this.cache.delete(cacheKey);
            });
            this.removeStoredResource(resource);
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sgpi:api-mutated', {
                detail: { method, endpoint: this.normalizeEndpoint(endpoint), resource, id: this.endpointId(endpoint), result }
            }));
            return;
        }

        this.cache.forEach((cached, cacheKey) => {
            if (!cached || !this.cacheMatchesResource(cached.endpoint, resource)) return;

            const patched = this.patchCachedValue(
                cached.value,
                method,
                entity,
                mutationId,
                this.isCollectionMutation(endpoint, resource)
                    && this.cacheAcceptsCreatedEntity(cacheKey)
            );
            if (!patched.changed) {
                this.cache.delete(cacheKey);
                return;
            }

            cached.value = patched.value;
            cached.locallyUpdatedUntil = now + this.localMutationWindow;
            this.cache.set(cacheKey, cached);
            retained.push([cacheKey, cached]);
        });
        this.removeStoredResource(resource);
        retained.forEach(([cacheKey, cached]) => this.writeStoredCache(cacheKey, cached));

        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sgpi:api-mutated', {
            detail: {
                method,
                endpoint: this.normalizeEndpoint(endpoint),
                resource,
                id: entity?.id ?? mutationId ?? null,
                entity,
                result
            }
        }));
    }

    patchCachedValue(value, method, entity, mutationId, isCollectionMutation) {
        if (Array.isArray(value)) {
            return this.patchArray(value, method, entity, mutationId, isCollectionMutation);
        }

        if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
            return { value, changed: false };
        }

        if (Array.isArray(value.data)) {
            const patched = this.patchArray(value.data, method, entity, mutationId, isCollectionMutation);
            if (!patched.changed) return { value, changed: false };

            const next = { ...value, data: patched.value };
            if (Number.isFinite(Number(next.total))) {
                const delta = patched.value.length - value.data.length;
                next.total = Math.max(0, Number(next.total) + delta);
            }
            return { value: next, changed: true };
        }

        const valueId = this.entityId(value);
        const targetId = this.entityId(entity) ?? mutationId;
        if (valueId !== null && targetId !== null && String(valueId) === String(targetId)) {
            if (method === 'DELETE') return { value: null, changed: true };
            return { value: { ...value, ...entity }, changed: true };
        }

        return { value, changed: false };
    }

    patchArray(items, method, entity, mutationId, isCollectionMutation) {
        const targetId = this.entityId(entity) ?? mutationId;
        const index = targetId === null
            ? -1
            : items.findIndex(item => String(this.entityId(item)) === String(targetId));

        if (method === 'DELETE') {
            if (index < 0) return { value: items, changed: false };
            return { value: items.filter((_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== index), changed: true };
        }

        if (!entity || typeof entity !== 'object') {
            return { value: items, changed: false };
        }

        if (index >= 0) {
            const meaningfulKeys = Object.keys(entity).filter(key => !['id', 'ID'].includes(key));
            if (meaningfulKeys.length === 0) {
                return { value: items, changed: false };
            }
            const next = [...items];
            next[index] = { ...next[index], ...entity };
            return { value: next, changed: true };
        }

        if (method === 'POST' && isCollectionMutation && this.entityId(entity) !== null) {
            return { value: [entity, ...items], changed: true };
        }

        return { value: items, changed: false };
    }

    mutationEntity(result, requestData, mutationId) {
        const preferredKeys = [
            'user', 'project', 'deliverable', 'evaluation', 'room', 'group',
            'asignatura', 'competencia', 'tag', 'document', 'notice',
            'exception', 'assignment', 'window', 'criterion', 'period'
        ];
        for (const key of preferredKeys) {
            if (result?.[key] && typeof result[key] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(result[key])) {
                return result[key];
            }
        }

        if (result && typeof result === 'object' && !Array.isArray(result) && this.entityId(result) !== null) {
            return result;
        }

        const requestObject = requestData instanceof FormData
            ? Object.fromEntries(requestData.entries())
            : requestData;
        const fallback = requestObject && typeof requestObject === 'object' && !Array.isArray(requestObject)
            ? { ...requestObject }
            : {};

        if (result && typeof result === 'object' && !Array.isArray(result)) {
            Object.entries(result).forEach(([key, value]) => {
                if (!['message', 'errors', 'error'].includes(key) && typeof value !== 'object') {
                    fallback[key] = value;
                }
            });
        }
        if (mutationId !== null && fallback.id === undefined) fallback.id = mutationId;
        return Object.keys(fallback).length ? fallback : null;
    }

    cacheMatchesResource(cachedEndpoint, resource) {
        if (!cachedEndpoint || !resource) return false;
        return cachedEndpoint === resource;
    }

    isCollectionMutation(endpoint, resource) {
        return this.normalizeEndpoint(endpoint) === resource;
    }

    cacheAcceptsCreatedEntity(cacheKey) {
        try {
            const url = new URL(String(cacheKey).replace(/^[A-Z]+:/, ''));
            return Number(url.searchParams.get('page') || 1) <= 1;
        } catch (error) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    resourceEndpoint(endpoint) {
        const normalized = this.normalizeEndpoint(endpoint);
        const knownResource = this.resourceEndpoints.find(resource => (
            normalized === resource || normalized.startsWith(`${resource}/`)
        ));
        if (knownResource) return knownResource;

        const segments = normalized.split('/').filter(Boolean);
        const idIndex = segments.findIndex(segment => /^\d+$/.test(segment));
        if (idIndex >= 0) {
            return `/${segments.slice(0, idIndex).join('/')}`;
        }
        return normalized;
    }

    endpointId(endpoint) {
        const normalized = this.normalizeEndpoint(endpoint);
        const resource = this.resourceEndpoint(normalized);
        const remainder = normalized.slice(resource.length).split('/').filter(Boolean);
        const first = remainder[0] || null;
        const actionNames = new Set([
            'archive-selected', 'unarchive-selected', 'import-excel',
            'send-credentials', 'apply-semester-change'
        ]);
        return first && !actionNames.has(first) ? first : null;
    }

    normalizeEndpoint(endpoint) {
        return `/${String(endpoint || '').split('?')[0].replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '')}`;
    }

    entityId(entity) {
        if (!entity || typeof entity !== 'object') return null;
        return entity.id ?? entity.ID ?? entity.user_id ?? entity.project_id ?? null;
    }

    async refreshAuthToken() {
        if (!this.refreshPromise) {
            this.refreshPromise = auth.refreshToken()
                .then(token => {
                    this.clearCache();
                    return token;
                })
                .finally(() => {
                    this.refreshPromise = null;
                });
        }

        return this.refreshPromise;
    }

    redirectToLogout(reason = 'unauthorized') {
        if (window.SGPI_AUTH_REDIRECTING) return;
        window.SGPI_AUTH_REDIRECTING = true;
        this.clearCache();
        auth.clearLocalSession();
        window.location.replace(`/pages/logout.php?reason=${encodeURIComponent(reason)}`);
    }

    defaultCacheTtl(endpoint) {
        const match = this.defaultCacheTtls.find(item => item.pattern.test(endpoint));
        return match ? match.ttl : 0;
    }

    storageKey(cacheKey) {
        const token = auth.getToken() || 'guest';
        return `${this.cachePrefix}${this.cacheScope(token)}:${cacheKey}`;
    }

    cacheScope(value) {
        let hash = 2166136261;
        const input = String(value || 'guest');
        for (let index = 0; index < input.length; index++) {
            hash ^= input.charCodeAt(index);
            hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
        }
        return (hash >>> 0).toString(36);
    }

    readStoredCache(cacheKey) {
        try {
            const cached = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(this.storageKey(cacheKey)) || 'null');
            if (!cached || cached.expiresAt <= Date.now()) {
                sessionStorage.removeItem(this.storageKey(cacheKey));
                return null;
            }
            return cached;
        } catch (error) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    writeStoredCache(cacheKey, value) {
        try {
            sessionStorage.setItem(this.storageKey(cacheKey), JSON.stringify(value));
            this.pruneStoredCache();
        } catch (error) {
            this.pruneStoredCache(true);
            try {
                sessionStorage.setItem(this.storageKey(cacheKey), JSON.stringify(value));
            } catch (retryError) {
                // Si el navegador no permite storage, la cache en memoria sigue funcionando.
            }
        }
    }

    removeStoredResource(resource) {
        try {
            Object.keys(sessionStorage)
                .filter(key => key.startsWith(this.cachePrefix))
                .forEach(key => {
                    const cached = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(key) || 'null');
                    if (this.cacheMatchesResource(cached?.endpoint, resource)) {
                        sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
                    }
                });
        } catch (error) {
            // La invalidacion en memoria sigue activa aunque storage no este disponible.
        }
    }

    pruneStoredCache(force = false) {
        try {
            const now = Date.now();
            const entries = Object.keys(sessionStorage)
                .filter(key => key.startsWith(this.cachePrefix))
                .map(key => {
                    const value = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(key) || 'null');
                    return { key, value };
                })
                .filter(entry => entry.value);

            entries
                .filter(entry => entry.value.expiresAt <= now)
                .forEach(entry => sessionStorage.removeItem(entry.key));

            const active = entries
                .filter(entry => entry.value.expiresAt > now)
                .sort((a, b) => Number(a.value.storedAt || 0) - Number(b.value.storedAt || 0));
            const keep = force ? Math.floor(this.maxStoredCacheEntries / 2) : this.maxStoredCacheEntries;
            active.slice(0, Math.max(0, active.length - keep))
                .forEach(entry => sessionStorage.removeItem(entry.key));
        } catch (error) {
            // No es necesario interrumpir una solicitud por mantenimiento de cache.
        }
    }

    translateError(message) {
        const replacements = {
            'The semestre field must be an integer.': 'El semestre debe ser un número válido.',
            'The grupo field must be a string.': 'El grupo debe ser un texto válido.',
            'The current password field must be a string.': 'La contraseña actual debe ser texto válido.',
            'The password field confirmation does not match.': 'La confirmación de contraseña no coincide.',
            'The password field must be at least 6 characters.': 'La contraseña debe tener al menos 6 caracteres.',
            'The direccion field format is invalid.': 'La dirección debe incluir un domicilio válido, con número y caracteres permitidos.',
            'The direccion field must be at least 10 characters.': 'La dirección debe tener al menos 10 caracteres.',
            'The nombre field is required.': 'El nombre es obligatorio.',
            'The fecha evaluacion field is required.': 'La fecha de evaluación es obligatoria.',
            'The teacher ids field must be an array.': 'Selecciona docentes válidos.',
            'The project ids field must be an array.': 'Selecciona proyectos válidos.'
        };

        let translated = String(message || '');
        Object.entries(replacements).forEach(([from, to]) => {
            translated = translated.replaceAll(from, to);
        });
        translated = translated.replaceAll('The ', 'El campo ')
            .replaceAll(' field is required.', ' es obligatorio.')
            .replaceAll(' field must be an integer.', ' debe ser un número válido.')
            .replaceAll(' field must be a string.', ' debe ser texto válido.')
            .replaceAll(' field format is invalid.', ' tiene un formato invalido.');
        return translated;
    }
}
